AKTA INSURANS 1996

PERINTAH INSURANS (PENGECUALIAN) (NO. 2) 2011

PADA menjalankan kuasa yang diberikan oleh seksyen 198 Akta Insurans

1996 [Akta 553], Menteri, setelah menimbangkan bahawa fakta yang akan

dikecualikan adalah selaras dengan maksud Akta ini dan demi kepentingan

awam, membuat perintah yang berikut:

Nama

1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Insurans (Pengecualian)

(No. 2) 2011.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Perintah ini—

 "Skim" ertinya "Skim Insurans untuk Kumpulan Sasar NKRA Low Income

Household" yang diaturkan oleh Yayasan Kebajikan Negara, sebagai pemunya

polisi kumpulan, untuk orang yang diinsuranskan di bawah Skim iaitu

ahli-ahli berdaftar "Data Kemiskinan Nasional" yang juga dikenali sebagai

"e-Kasih";

 "Penanggung insurans Skim" ertinya penanggung insurans bagi Skim,

iaitu Allianz Life Insurance Malaysia Berhad dan Allianz General Insurance

Company (Malaysia) Berhad, kedua-duanya merupakan penanggung insurans

berlesen; dan

 "Yayasan Kebajikan Negara" ertinya Yayasan Kebajikan Negara yang

didaftarkan di bawah Akta Pemegang Amanah (Perbadanan) 1952 [Akta 258],

pemunya polisi kumpulan bagi Skim.

Pengecualian daripada subseksyen 186(4) Akta

INSURANCE ACT 1996

INSURANCE (EXEMPTION) (NO. 2) ORDER 2011

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 198 of the Insurance Act

1996 [Act 553], the Minister, after having considered that the matters to be

exempted are consistent with the purposes of the Act and are in the interest

of the public, makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Insurance (Exemption) (No. 2) Order

Interpretation

2. In this Order—

 "Scheme" means the "Skim Insurans untuk Kumpulan Sasar NKRA Low

Income Household" arranged by Yayasan Kebajikan Negara, as the group

policy owner, for persons insured under the Scheme who are the registered

members of the "Data Kemiskinan Nasional" also known as "e-Kasih";

P.U. (A) 246.

 "Scheme insurers" means the insurers of the Scheme, Allianz Life Insurance

Malaysia Berhad and Allianz General Insurance Company (Malaysia) Berhad,

both of which are licensed insurers; and

 "Yayasan Kebajikan Negara" means the Yayasan Kebajikan Negara, registered

under the Trustees (Incorporation) Act 1952 [Act 258], the group policy owner

of the Scheme.

Exemption from subsection 186(4) of the Act

3. The Scheme insurers, in the case of the death of a person insured under

a group policy of the Scheme, are exempted from subsection 186(4) of the

Act in order that payment of moneys due under the group policy is paid to

Yayasan Kebajikan Negara, who shall receive and distribute such moneys

on behalf of the person insured in accordance with applicable distribution

laws.

Dated 13 July 2011

[BNM. JP.1157/1/1; PN(PU2

)570/V]

 DATO' SERI AHMAD HUSNI BIN MOHD HANADZLAH

Second Minister of Finance

P.U. (A) 246.
